axiom_audit_reading: The admissibility criterion is that NOTHING appears beyond the standard three [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Fifteen of the eighteen theorems use strictly LESS: eleven need only [propext] and four depend on no axioms at all, because they are decided by `decide` over integer arithmetic on the 2^6 = 64 points. A subset of the standard three is strictly stronger, not weaker. Crucially Lean.ofReduceBool appears nowhere, so no native_decide leaked in; the module was written with `decide` precisely to make that impossible.
